name: dsh-browser-compat
description: Restores crypto.randomUUID on insecure origins (plain-HTTP remote access) with a getRandomValues-based UUIDv4 shim injected at the front of index.html <head>.

plugin.descriptionZh: 当浏览器因非安全上下文（明文 HTTP 外网地址）缺少 crypto.randomUUID 时，仅用 getRandomValues 生成 UUIDv4；不改变授权、不绕过任何安全校验。
